one_line: A Gandhara–Mathura artisan shaping early Buddhist images under Kushan patronage.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, lean but sturdy craftsman’s build
appearance.face: oval face, medium wheat-brown complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard along jawline, a healed small scar on left cheek, default expression focused and calm with thoughtful eyes
appearance.hair: thick black hair gathered into a short, low knot at the back of the head, sides combed smooth, front lightly parted; wrapped with a narrow off-white cotton headband tied above the right ear
appearance.costume: a knee-length long-sleeved tunic (kurta-like) of undyed off-white cotton, simple round neck and slightly flared hem, worn over loose ankle-length trousers in muted earthy tan; a deep red cotton waist sash wrapped twice around the hips and knotted on the left with its ends hanging; a light woolen shawl in dusty teal draped over the left shoulder and across the back, practical leather sandals in dark brown, and a simple thin bronze bangle on the right wrist
appearance.signature: a medium-length wooden mallet in his right hand and a slender iron chisel in his left, with a small polished fragment of red sandstone tucked into the red waist sash at his hip

ref_desc: A lean wheat-brown Kushan-era sculptor with an oval face, short knot of black hair and off-white headband, in off-white tunic, tan trousers, deep red sash, dusty teal shawl and dark brown sandals, holding a wooden mallet, iron chisel and red sandstone fragment.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style Kushan-era master sculptor: a lean wheat-brown man in his early 30s with an oval face, straight nose, small scar on his left cheek, and a neatly trimmed moustache and short beard, wearing thick black hair gathered in a short knot at the back with the sides combed smooth and front lightly parted, wrapped by a narrow off-white cotton headband tied above his right ear. He wears a knee-length long-sleeved off-white cotton tunic with a simple round neck over loose ankle-length earthy tan trousers, a deep red cotton waist sash wrapped twice around his hips and knotted on the left with its ends hanging, a dusty teal woolen shawl draped over his left shoulder and across his back, and dark brown leather sandals; a thin bronze bangle circles his right wrist. In his hands he firmly grips a medium-length wooden mallet and a slender iron chisel, with a small polished fragment of red sandstone tucked into his deep red sash at the hip. Show him standing in a neutral pose, front-facing, with focused calm expression and thoughtful eyes, clearly displaying his face, headband, hair knot, layered tunic and trousers, sash and shawl, sandals, and his tools, with off-white, earthy tan, deep red, dusty teal and dark brown as the dominant colours.
